'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2024 Ecuadorian conflict]]
**All 178 prison employees who were held hostage in at least seven prisons are released. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/1/14/ecuador-prison-staff-held-hostage-by-inmates-all-freed (Al Jazeera)]
*[[2023 Israel–Hamas war hostage crisis]]
**Around 120,000 people attend the start of a 24-hour rally in [[Tel Aviv]]'s [[Hostages Square]] to mark 100 days since 240 [[2023 Israel–Hamas war hostage crisis|hostages were kidnapped into Gaza]] during the [[2023 Hamas-led attack on Israel]] on October 7. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/were-done-enough-120k-attend-24-hour-rally-marking-100-days-since-hostages-taken/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
*[[Syrian civil war]], [[2024 Iran–Israel conflict]], [[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**Five IDF soldiers and four [[Tahrir al-Sham|Syrian Glory of Islam Brigade]] militants killed in a fire fight in [[Shebaa]], Israel.[https://www.jns.org/five-idf-soldiers-wounded-as-terrorists-infiltrate-from-lebanon/ (JNS)] 
'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023–2024 Sundhnúkur eruptions]]
**The Reykjanes volcano erupts near the town of [[Grindavík]], [[Iceland]], with one fissure forming inside the town limits. [https://www.cnn.com/2024/01/13/europe/iceland-volcanic-evacuation-grindavik-intl-hnk/index.html (CNN)]
**Five [[Illegal immigration|migrant]]s die while attempting to cross the [[English Channel]] after their small boat overturned. Dozens more are rescued, according to the [[Maritime prefect|French Maritime Prefecture]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-67973718 (BBC News)]

'''International relations'''
*[[India–Maldives relations]]
**The [[Maldives]] calls for the complete withdrawal of the [[Indian Armed Forces]] from its territory by March 15 amid [[India–Maldives derogatory remarks|a diplomatic dispute]] between the two countries. [[India]] currently has around 80 troops stationed on the archipelago. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/maldives-calls-withdrawal-indian-troops-by-march-15-2024-01-14/ (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Inauguration of Bernardo Arévalo]]
**In [[Guatemala]], the [[Constitutional Court of Guatemala|Constitutional Court]] aligns itself with the outgoing [[Vamos (Guatemala)|ruling party]] and denies legal recourse to [[Semilla (political party)|Semilla]], affirming that Semilla's elected members of [[Congress of the Republic of Guatemala|Congress]] must assume office as "[[Independent politician|independents]]", thereby disqualifying them from running for the [[List of presidents of the Congress of the Republic of Guatemala|presidency of the Congress]]. The legislature of the outgoing Congress subsequently announces a delay in the investiture of the incoming legislature, as well as in the presidential investiture of [[Bernardo Arévalo]]. [https://www.prensalibre.com/guatemala/justicia/cc-no-otorga-amparo-al-movimiento-semilla-y-se-eleva-la-tension-en-el-congreso-por-junta-calificadora-de-credenciales-breaking/ (''Prensa Libre'')]
**Despite the Constitutional Court's ruling, [[Samuel Pérez Álvarez]], a member of [[Semilla (political party)|Semilla]], is elected President of the Congress with 92 votes. [https://www.prensalibre.com/ahora/guatemala/politica/planilla-2-encabezada-por-samuel-perez-obtiene-92-votos-y-gana-presidencia-del-legislativo/ (''Prensa Libre'')]
*[[2024 Comorian presidential election]]
**The [[Comoros]] hold the first round of presidential elections. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/comoros-holds-presidential-election-incumbent-largely-expected-win-2024-01-14/ (Reuters)]
*[[Abdication of Margrethe II]]
**[[Frederik X]] is proclaimed [[Monarchy of Denmark|King of Denmark]] following [[Abdication of Margrethe II|his mother's abdication]]. [https://apnews.com/article/denmark-queen-king-margrethe-frederik-abdication-22d9356ab4bad4b058b2305fa8730a27 (AP)]
